Weekly review 2026-07-27: Month 1 closed. Production hit target (39 reels/29 shorts/128 articles), conversion did not (9 FB followers, 8 engagement, 7 email subs flat 2wks). Opened Month 2 (7/28-8/27) with targets rebuilt off real 14-day pace.

Published /blog/thumbtack-refunds-chargebacks-deactivation/ — the money-cluster gap flagged 3 weeks running. Refund categories + 45-day window + the bank-chargeback trap that gets pro accounts held. Sources: BBB (931 complaints/3yr, 251/12mo, verbatim pro complaint), Thumbtack help docs. Info gain: our math that filing every eligible refund is worth ~$62/booked job.

Added 6 reels weighted to what actually scored in July — pricing/getting-paid drama and stat-led proof (chargeback-trap, refund-monday, first-to-answer, 519-reviews, eight-automations, rented-pipeline). Pure gag reels scored 0 reactions; runway back to 12 days.

Fixed /share-your-story/: the form POSTed to /api/story, which returned 404 since launch — every contractor submission was silently dropped. Added the endpoint (stores to CR_KV) + gated /ops/stories reader. This is why phase-2 EEAT has zero real quotes. Deploys on the next hourly CI run.
